messages:
mia (infra): kicking off APSE2 capacity reservation for the new cluster. target is 48 A100s for initial bake + 12 spare for smoke tests
andre: thanks — is that 48 locked for the first month or a rolling commit?
mia (infra): month 1 reserved commit, then 3-month review. pricing estimate in the ticket below.
samir: tagging quotas team: @lisa can you start the quota request with GCP? include the SKU IDs, region, and desired start/end times.
lisa: on it. do we have a template for the request?
mia (infra): use this ticket body (copy+paste):
```
Project: redwood-inference-prod
Region: asia-southeast2 (apse2)
Resource: NVIDIA A100 80GB (accelerator.googleapis.com/instance_quota)
Quantity: 60 (48 reserved + 12 spare)
Start: 2026-06-01T00:00Z
End: 2026-09-01T00:00Z
Justification: new cluster bring-up for APSE2. Required for onboarding Dedicated pools and customer validation. We'll provide SLOs and expected sustained usage patterns.
Contact: infra-oncall@redwood.ai
```
andre: add cost bucket and approval chain in the ticket: finance needs the monthly commit and burn-rate estimate.
mia (infra): finance numbers: base reserved = $78k/mo, est variable for burst ~ $9k/mo. add 10% contingency.
samir: operational checklist for reservation handoff:
- confirm quota approval email + console change
- provision node pool with taints/labels
- run provisioning smoke: `kubectl apply -f apse2-smoke.yaml`
- validate drivers + cuda + container runtime
- run health endpoints and perf baseline
- document rollback window and fallback model routing

lisa: quota request sent (ticket #Q-1492). reservations-bot: reservation pending approval. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
reservations-bot: Reservation request Q-1492 created, awaiting quota team approval.
andre: once quota is granted, I'll reserve the capacity with the cloud rep and confirm start date. I'll post the reservation ID here.
mia (infra): validation commands to run after nodes ready:
```
# check GPUs and drivers
kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep apse2
kubectl exec -it <gpu-pod> -- nvidia-smi
kubectl logs <runtime-pod> | tail -n 200
# perf smoke
curl -sS http://ap-southeast2-lb.internal/health | jq .
ab -n 100 -c 10 http://ap-southeast2-infer.internal/sample_prompt
```
samir: add autoscaler policy: minNodes 2 per pool, targetUtilization 0.65, maxNodes based on reserved capacity. I'll push the HCL to infra repo.
lisa: quota approved by GCP. console shows quota updated to 60. sending confirmation to ticket and finance. :tada:
mia (infra): awesome — run day-0 handoff at 09:30 UTC tomorrow. checklist for handoff:
- reservations-bot: create reservation with ID R-7421 (done)
- infra oncall: provision node pools + attach IAM roles
- runtime team: deploy runtime with kernel optimizations
- QA: run perf suite and baseline logs uploaded to S3

andre: R-7421 created and linked in ticket. provisioning started.
reservations-bot: Reservation R-7421 activated.
lisa: finance notified and invoice hold set for reserved commit.
mia (infra): post-provision validation notes (to follow) — if perf deviates >15% from expected baseline, auto-roll back and route traffic to fallback-region.
samir: noted. I'll watch the metrics dashboard and set alerts. :eyes:
andre: thanks all, will update thread with node IPs and gpustat output once ready.
mia (infra): any blockers?
lisa: nothing on my side.
andre: kube quota limit hit on first create attempt, re-run with batch size 6 -> succeeded. added to runbook. :white_check_mark:
mia (infra): perfect. See you at handoff. :rocket:
